### Lumentum Announces Speaker Lineup at 2026 OCP Global Summit


October 1, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/377324469/files/doc_news/Lumentum-Announces-Speaker-Lineup-at-2026-OCP-Global-Summit-2026.pdf)


*Lumentum experts to discuss external laser sources, VCSELs, and optical circuit switching for AI networks*


SAN JOSE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Lumentum, a global leader in optical and photonic technology, today announced its speaker lineup at the[2026 Open Compute Project (OCP) Global Summit](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.opencompute.org%2Fsummit%2Fglobal-summit&esheet=54613725&newsitemid=20261001653795&lan=en-US&anchor=2026+Open+Compute+Project+%28OCP%29+Global+Summit&index=1&md5=0350a18f6ff7bbcfdfe3d3269c8b575f) , themed “Scaling Innovation for the AI Era.” The event will take place from October 12 – 15 at the San Jose McEnery Convention Center.


- **External Laser Source Architectures for Deployable CPO-Based AI Networks​**


- **Christian Urricariet** , Senior Director, Product and Strategic Marketing
- Wednesday, October 14 from 1:10 – 1:25 p.m.
- SJCC - Concourse Level - 210AE​


- **Panel: Slow and Wide 12.8T VCSEL Solutions​**


- **Oleg Shchekin** , Head of High-Density Interconnect
- Wednesday, October 14 from 1:50 – 2:15 p.m.
- SJCC - Concourse Level - 210AE​


- **Zero-Touch OCS Fabrics for AI Scale-Out Infrastructure at Hyperscale​**


- Joint presentation led by Kannan Raj, Architect at Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
- **Michael DeMerchant** , Senior Director, Product Line Management, OCS at Lumentum
- Thursday, October 15 from 8:45 – 9:05 a.m.
- SJCC - Concourse Level - 210AE​


For more information, visit[OCP Global Summit | Lumentum](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lumentum.com%2Fen%2Fevents%2Focp-global-summit&esheet=54613725&newsitemid=20261001653795&lan=en-US&anchor=OCP+Global+Summit+%7C+Lumentum&index=2&md5=1ba62923c44bdff86fc09117249aedc9) .


**About Lumentum**


Lumentum (NASDAQ: LITE) is a global leader in optical and photonic technologies that power the networks and infrastructure behind AI, cloud computing, and next-generation communications. Built on decades of photonics innovation, Lumentum delivers high-performance lasers, modules, and optical subsystems that enable scalable, energy-efficient data center connectivity, advanced telecom networks, industrial manufacturing, and sensing applications. Headquartered in San Jose, California, the company operates R&D, manufacturing, and sales facilities worldwide. Learn more at[www.lumentum.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.lumentum.com&esheet=54613725&newsitemid=20261001653795&lan=en-US&anchor=www.lumentum.com&index=3&md5=5006638e4991386ae09082dfbdd86fdb) .
